limitations: V1 is single-process and in-process because the current JSON queue lives on the web service Render disk; horizontal scaling requires migration to a transactional shared queue.
Ambiguous RUNNING tasks are blocked after restart instead of automatically replayed because arbitrary handler side effects are not checkpointed.
Jarvis generic tasks without a registered safe local handler route to ESCALATION_REQUIRED; no Claude/Codex provider connector is invoked automatically.
Docker is not installed in the verification environment, so the production image build was not executed locally.
unresolved_issues: The repository-wide suite retains three unrelated pre-existing failures: one frozen Funding checksum mismatch and two stale Research Control Plane experiment-count expectations (8 expected, 9 canonical).
suggested_next_tasks: Deploy only after explicit approval and verify QUEUED to terminal-state processing on the persistent production queue.
Implement a separately approved provider connector for manual premium escalation packets.
Migrate the queue to PostgreSQL or Render Key Value before enabling multiple web processes or service replicas.
